source: Owner direct chat after playing MSQ-120
owner_message_original: Поиграл, пока плохо с пративником. Что бы это стало хоть сколько нибудь интересно, его базовая скорость в режиме боя должна быть такой же как у гг. Сделай это, без такси и проверяющего
owner_message_english_translation: I played; the opponent is still poor. To make this at least somewhat interesting, his base speed in combat mode must be the same as the protagonist's. Do this without a task or reviewer.
decision: Direct bounded follow-up to MSQ-120: match the enabled enemy's ordinary standing combat movement to the player's 360 cm/s base speed and keep mobile fire compatible with that speed.
execution: Controller edits directly; no new Multica task, executor or independent reviewer. Native build and focused source/asset inspection only; gameplay remains owner-tested. Commit the scoped changes locally.
